obligations.task: Freeze the Quizzler source identity for offline evidence.

obligations.stopCondition: Block on missing, stale, or unmet readiness requirements (asc-build, testflight-receipt).

obligations.task: Run the authoritative Quizzler local gate (app/test-gate.sh).
obligations.stopCondition: Block on any gate failure or leaked simulator device.

obligations.task: Prepare the Quizzler TestFlight candidate manifest via app/scripts/prepare_testflight_candidate.py.
obligations.stopCondition: Block until a frozen, readiness-backed candidate manifest exists.

obligations.task: Validate the same candidate-preparation contract's archive output.
obligations.stopCondition: Block when the candidate manifest cannot prove an archived, signable build.

obligations.task: Emit the inert signing plan via app/scripts/provision_signing.py --dry-run (no credential use).
obligations.stopCondition: Block when the dry-run plan cannot resolve the pinned Production provisioning profile.

obligations.task: Verify current-candidate device evidence offline via app/scripts/device_acceptance.py --verify-only.
obligations.stopCondition: Block on missing, stale, or mismatched artifact/device evidence.

obligations.task: Reconcile current-candidate production evidence via app/scripts/reconcile_production.py against the tracked example device-evidence document.
obligations.stopCondition: Block until reconciled evidence proves canonical-state agreement.

obligations.task: Write one immutable offline receipt when every prerequisite obligation is independently proven.

manualBoundaries: app/deploy-testflight remains the fixed external boundary; no upload/assignment operation class is declared by this offline adapter.
Real TestFlight upload requires walkthroughCapture and release.proof.upload-attestation.v1, neither of which exist yet for Quizzler; that is out of scope for this adoption pass.

App Store Connect broker credential use (quizzler-testflight-upload, quizzler-asc-provision, quizzler-testflight-receipt-prep) requires explicit owner authorization and fresh evidence; none is exercised offline.

Production CloudKit schema state, signed physical-device behavior, App Store Connect processing, tester assignment, and user-visible TestFlight availability remain unproven by a local or offline pass.
